fields.PRODUCT NAME: Shubh Aangan – Rajasthani Hand-Painted Wooden Temple
fields.DESCRIPTION: Bring sacred elegance and cultural charm to your home with the Shubh Aangan – Rajasthani Hand-Painted Wooden Temple. Expertly handcrafted by local artisans, this vibrant mandir features intricate floral patterns, traditional archwork, and a warm red-and-gold palette that reflects the artistic soul of Rajasthan.
